Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Vihaan - 11 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Hema - 41 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Rajesh - 43 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater
4. Sharda - 69 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Vihaan stands in the living room. Hema and Rajesh stand near him.]

Rajesh: "What lovely weather!"

[Vihaan writes in his notebook.]

Rajesh: "That was fun!"

[Vihaan studies for his exam.]

Vihaan: "How beautiful!"

[Vihaan does his homework at the table.]

Vihaan (gently): "That's easy."

[Vihaan's phone rings and he answers it.]

Rajesh: "Okay, Hema."

[Vihaan watches cartoons on TV.]

Rajesh (gently): "Hmm, I see."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Hema and Sharda stand near him.]

Vihaan: "Grandma, look over here."

[Vihaan runs to Mother.]

Hema: "Yes, all right."

[Vihaan jumps with joy.]

Vihaan: "That was such a fun day!"
